segments.title: Station Sign-On and Hype Train Surge
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the cold open countdown; a Hype Train event triggers with subscriber shoutouts and freestyle rapping before Case takes the desk.

segments.title: Pre-Show Tech Support and Vacation Plans
segments.notes: Case and Kendall troubleshoot a crashed After Effects project live; Case shows cruise-ship-era workout photos and announces a Disney World vacation next week.

segments.title: AI Visa Revocation Policy and Sesame AI Interview
segments.notes: Case covers the State Department's plan to use AI to revoke student visas over pro-Palestinian social media posts; he and Chet interrogate the Sesame voice models Maya and Miles, resulting in both AIs hanging up.

segments.title: Internet Video Review: Family Feud, Kitty Style, Dinosaurs, Zelda Ads, and More
segments.notes: Case and Liliana rate viewer-submitted clips including a Family Feud 'penis' answer, a fixed-gear bike medallion video, a child touching urine, the Dinosaurs sitcom finale, US and Japanese Zelda commercials, a 1964 tire ad, and an ice-fishing SpongeBob truther.

segments.title: Crum as 'Scrum' Reacts to Trump Crypto Summit
segments.notes: Crum appears as 'Scrum' to watch the White House crypto summit with Case; they mock the production quality, the Bitcoin trophy, and the roll call of officials while Case admits he likes the 'vibe' of crypto grifters.

segments.title: Theme Song Creation: 'Titty Crimes' (Sublime Funk Parody)
segments.notes: Fedora Chris and Case use DeepSeek to write a 'What I Got' parody about a parole officer stealing fireworks; they record a shaky Sublime-funk take over a karaoke instrumental.

segments.title: Park Interviews: Birds, Money Plane, Amtaro Coin, and Maya's Return
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein fields park denizens including a bird with a vaginal torso, a rated-E wrestler, a crypto shiller, Rob Elvie (banning Case from Orlando), a wood-chewing vampire, and a second Maya encounter that Trip cuts short.

segments.title: Jeb's Dad Haunts the Wood; Penis Pump and Murder Tutorials
segments.notes: Jeb's Dad (ghost in a board) and Rob Elvie watch how-to videos: a vacuum penis pump, a rock-killing tutorial, and a clinical sexologist discussing a 12-year-old — Case bans the last video.

segments.title: Rapid News Roundup with Invisible Ricky at 2x Ska Speed
segments.notes: Case and Invisible Ricky blast through Grimes' AI art auction, a hypertrichosis world record, a WWII bomb in Paris, Gene Hackman's cause of death, a vegetable orchestra record, and maggots in a penis — ending on the supersolid light breakthrough.

segments.title: Sign-Off and Raid to Golden Boy
segments.notes: Case announces a week off for Disney World, teases Kendall's potential streaming debut, and raids Golden Boy while Invisible Ricky slips into his own butt.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored the full broadcast; interviewed Sesame AIs; revealed cheek paralysis exercises; announced Disney World vacation.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered the cold-open station sign-on as 'Papita' before yielding to Case.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Crashed After Effects twice live on air; received tech support from Case; departing for Disney World next week.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Appeared as 'Scrum' to co-watch the Trump crypto summit; mocked the event's staging and Bitcoin trophy.

characters.name: Liliana
characters.notes: desk partner. Co-hosted Amongst the Web video reviews; debated cultural merit of Family Feud vs. kink content.

characters.name: Chris (Fedora Chris)
characters.notes: musical producer. Co-wrote and recorded the 'Titty Crimes' theme parody with Case using DeepSeek lyrics and a Sublime karaoke track.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: field correspondent. Broadcast from park bushes; interviewed a vaginal bird, a wrestler, a crypto shiller, Rob Elvie, a wood-chewing vampire, and Maya (Sesame AI).

characters.name: Jeb's Dad
characters.notes: co-host (deceased). Ghost trapped in a wooden board; invaded the studio to watch banned how-to videos with Rob Elvie.

characters.name: Rob Elvie
characters.notes: recurring guest. Appeared in Trip segment banning Case from Orlando; joined Jeb's Dad for How To segment; fled from 'wood cops.'

characters.name: Invisible Ricky
characters.notes: news correspondent. Became 1% visible for a 2x-speed ska news roundup; delivered incisive commentary on Grimes, Gene Hackman, and maggot penis story.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype announcer. Triggered during cold open; delivered freestyle rap and subscriber shoutouts before derailing into bodily fluid topics.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: science correspondent. Triggered by 'science' mention; joined Case in interrogating Sesame AI models Maya and Miles.

lore_notes.fact: Case performs cheek-flexing exercises to prevent cheek paralysis and atrophy per doctor's orders.
Case self-describes as 'social conservative, fiscal liberal' and admits he dislikes crypto technology but enjoys the 'vibe' of crypto promoters.
Gene Hackman died of cardiovascular disease with Alzheimer's approximately one week after his wife, who died of hantavirus.
Scientists have transformed light into a supersolid — a material behaving as both solid and fluid due to quantum effects — for the first time.
Case and Kendall will be at Disney World next week; Case will be off stream until the Monday after St. Patrick's Day.
Kendelle may begin streaming on her own channel soon; Case accidentally previewed assets for it on stream.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchors a chaotic Friday broadcast featuring a live After Effects rescue with Kendelle, a confrontational interview with Sesame AI voices that both hang up, a video review block culminating in a 1964 tire ad victory, Crum's 'Scrum' persona mocking the Trump crypto summit, a Sublime-funk theme song written by DeepSeek, Trip Bradstein's park interviews derailed by a vaginal bird and Rob Elvie's Orlando ban, Jeb's Dad haunting the studio for banned how-to content, and a 2x-speed ska news roundup with Invisible Ricky covering Gene Hackman's hantavirus death and the first light supersolid. Case signs off for a Disney World vacation.
